finding.text_under_review: every null geodesic generator of I+ is future-complete: it is defined for all values of the affine parameter induced by gtilde; equivalently every future-directed null geodesic reaching I+ has infinite affine length with respect to g
finding.issue: The asserted equivalence is not generally valid under conformal compactification. For gtilde = Omega^2 g with Omega -> 0 at I+, null geodesics have the same unparametrized curves but affine parameters transform by a nonconstant conformal factor; physical affine length can be infinite while the unphysical gtilde affine parameter reaches the boundary at a finite value.
finding.risk: This can silently strengthen or contradict the WCC class depending on which metric defines completeness, and makes the F1 formal predicate ambiguous even though structural checks pass.
finding.required_decision: F1 lead must choose one metric/parameter convention, state the transformation law or cite the exact conformal-completion convention, and update the minimal candidate or disposition the sentence as a non-semantic clarification before FROZEN rev30.
finding.stop_rule: Do not publish F1/FROZEN or promote G-FORM while this field is unresolved.
